goal: Prevent nodes from silently freezing without advancing the chain when block storage becomes inaccessible
Replace hard assertion crashes during block read errors with graceful shutdown
agreement: Unaddressed objection: introduces index regressions and ignores errors (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: missing blocks dir falsely reports tx not found under txindex (w0xlt)
Contested approach objection: returning null instead of throwing loses failure context (josibake)
Contested approach objection: leaves inconsistent filesystem error handling across execution paths (maflcko)
Support for improved reliability and extensive error-simulation test coverage (frankomosh, l0rinc, sedited)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it replaces an abrupt process abort during peer message processing with a graceful shutdown
The crash is only triggered by rare filesystem read errors when handling block transaction requests

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it fixes a silent chain freeze when storage volumes detach or permissions fail
Nodes currently appear healthy while permanently unable to advance the chain upon I/O errors
